scope: Two fictional smoke cases, not benchmark or teacher acceptance

notes: Named familiar characters in a picture book.
Shared a short picnic story with picture prompts.
Retold the beginning and middle of a familiar story to a small group. Needed a teacher question to explain the ending.
results.narrative: The child is developing their storytelling and literacy skills through regular engagement with books and stories. Over recent months, the child has shown a growing confidence in sharing narratives, from naming familiar characters in picture books to sharing a short picnic story using picture prompts. More recently, when retelling a familiar story to a small group, the child successfully described the beginning and middle sections. With a gentle guiding question from a teacher, the child was then able to explain the story's ending.
